app.title: Android Utility
theme.label: Theme
processes.recording_tooltip: Track CPU and memory usage over a session. Starting resets the previous counters.
apps.refresh_tooltip: Reads the installed application list from the device again.
apps.system_tooltip: System application. Uninstalling or disabling it may brick the device.
apps.disable_system_tooltip: Android may block disabling system applications from ADB.
apps.load_names_tooltip: Reads every APK from the device to resolve application names. This can take a long time.
apps.load_name_tooltip: Reads this application's APK to resolve its name. Slower than the package name but affects one app only.
optimization.refresh_tooltip: Reads the installed applications, the Device Idle whitelist, and background execution policies from the device again.
optimization.unavailable: The Doze whitelist could not be loaded. Use Refresh to try again.
optimization.doze_ignore_tooltip: Currently not ignoring Doze. Click to ignore Doze and add this package to the Device Idle whitelist.
optimization.doze_not_ignore_tooltip: Currently ignoring Doze. Click to stop ignoring and remove this package from the Device Idle whitelist.
optimization.doze_unknown_tooltip: The Doze whitelist could not be loaded.
optimization.background_unknown_tooltip: The background execution state is not available.
optimization.background_allow_tooltip: Click to allow background execution (RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND allow).
optimization.background_deny_tooltip: Click to deny background execution (RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND ignore).
status.doze_unwhitelisted_ok: {name} is no longer ignored by Doze.
status.background_allowed_ok: {name} may now run in the background.
status.background_ignored_ok: {name} is now restricted from running in the background.
session.title: Resource usage summary
error.adb_not_found: ADB was not found. Install Android platform tools and add them to PATH.
error.permission_denied: The device denied this action. Recent Android versions block disabling or removing system applications through ADB. Details: {message}
error.unsupported_command: This Android version does not support {command}. Details: {message}
error.cache_directory: Could not create the application cache directory: {error}
error.label_cache: Could not save the application-name cache: {error}
confirm.uninstall_message: Remove {name} ({package}) for the current user? This user's application data will be deleted.
confirm.system_warning: Warning: this is a system application. Removing it may brick the device.
confirm.load_names_message: Reading every APK from the device can take a long time, especially with many applications installed. Load all application names now?
